args: Fares are stored in cents as int64, never as floats.
A booking holds a seat for 15 minutes before payment.
Boarding-pass SMS messages go through Twilio from internal/notify/sms.go.
Sailing times are stored in UTC and shown in the harbour's local time.
Vehicle tickets need the vehicle's registration plate.
